text:
Ellen (Product): @channel quick GA note: tomorrow 09:00 PT were promoting Hosted ToolBridge v1 to stable for all hosted API customers. ToolBridge unifies streaming, tool-calling, and structured events with lower tail latency. Opt-in for now via header or query flag; rollout plan below. :tada:

Tom (Eng): Good. Any breaking changes?

Ellen (Product): No breaking changes. Opt-in header `X-ToolBridge: 1` or `?toolbridge=1`. Example curl: 

```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
     -H 'X-ToolBridge: 1' \
     -d '{"model":"mosaicx","input":"Find me a nearby coffee shop","tools":[{"name":"places_api"}],"stream":true}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Sana (Docs): Docs PR merged: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4890. Migration guide, quick diffs, and SDK flags for node/python are ready; publishing at deploy.

Ravi (SRE): Ops notes: Canary sequence us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1, 20m windows. Abort criteria: sustained p95 > 900ms or error rate >1.7x baseline. Fallback: automatic routing to `/v0/legacy-tools` for affected keys for 10m. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/toolbridge-ga (pinned).

Mei (ML): Model note: multiplexing strategy adjusted for frequent short tool calls; evals on 10 customer prompt suites show no quality regression and a median token cost drop ~6% for tool-heavy flows. We'll surface any function-call misalignments to Optimize.

Tom (Eng): Will SDKs expose a `toolBridge:true` option?

Ellen (Product): Yes. SDKs will add `toolBridge: true` and the CLI quickstart will include migration snippets. No change to `tools` array shape.

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy job tb-198111. Canary start 2026-03-28T16:00:00Z. Logs will be posted here.

Ravi (SRE): Canary +4m: p50 105ms, p95 360ms, errors flat. Proceeding to us-east-1.

Sana (Docs): Published migration note under /docs/toolbridge and added a short FAQ about ordering and truncated events.

Mei (ML): Enabled eval hooks for tool-call alignment; alert if mismatch rate >0.4%.

DeployBot: Canary complete: succeeded. Starting regional rollout.

Ravi (SRE): Regional rollout complete for initial regions. No aborts. Closing monitoring window in 10m.

Ellen (Product): Thanks team  will post GA summary and early metrics in 48h. If any customers see ordering issues or truncated tool outputs tag @Ravi and @Tom. Excited to get this into production! :rocket:
